market_definition: The structural acrylic adhesives market comprises two-part reactive methacrylate and acrylic adhesives that form high-strength bonds on metals, plastics and composites. It measures sales of finished adhesives, including primer-free and surface-tolerant grades. BY CHEMISTRY: Methyl Methacrylate (MMA), Urethane Methacrylate, Other Methacrylate Systems. BY MIXING SYSTEM: Pre-Mix Paste / No-Mix, Static-Mix Dual Cartridge, Bulk Metered Systems. BY CURE SPEED: Fast-Cure, Standard-Cure, Slow-Cure. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Automotive & Transportation, Aerospace & Defense, Wind Energy & Marine, Building & Construction, Industrial Assembly & Machinery, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Acrylic emulsion adhesives; acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesives; anaerobic and cyanoacrylate adhesives; foam-core acrylic bonding tapes. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
